transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I guess… I’m here because of the foreclosure situation. I know everyone keeps saying it’s just paperwork and missed payments, and I’m trying not to sound unreasonable, but it doesn’t feel like that to me.

For almost two years I’ve been seeing things that make it pretty clear the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been… kind of quietly working together to push me out of my house. And when they show me papers, it doesn’t really change what I know I’ve been seeing. I just thought maybe I should talk to someone, because people keep acting like I’m making too much of it.
Have you had the feeling that someone can put thoughts into your mind or control your thoughts?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I have my own thoughts, as far as I can tell. Nobody is, like, putting words in my head or taking over my mind or anything like that.

I know I probably sound worried about other things, but that part… no, I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I hear normal things, obviously, like neighbors or the TV if it’s on, but not voices when nobody’s there.

That would be important to say if it was happening, right? I’m not trying to hide anything. I just haven’t noticed that.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?

Not really, no. I mean, I have stressful nights where I don’t sleep great, but I wouldn’t say I felt unusually energetic or like I didn’t need sleep.

If that’s what you’re asking, I don’t think that’s been happening.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

I don’t think so… not most of the day nearly every day. I mean, I get down or overwhelmed sometimes, but I wouldn’t want to say it’s depression if that’s not really what it is.

I guess I’m not sure where the line is, but no, I haven’t been feeling depressed like that all the time.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or doesn’t make sense?

I don’t think so. I mean, maybe if I’m stressed I might explain things a little too fast or go in circles, but no one’s really told me I don’t make sense.

Do I seem hard to follow right now? I’m trying to answer clearly.
Have you found yourself losing interest or motivation to do everyday things you used to keep up with?

I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest in everything, no. I still get up for work, I supervise my team, handle schedules, deal with customer issues… and I’m taking care of myself okay, I think.

It’s more like when something connects to the foreclosure—like mail, bank calls, or paperwork at work that feels tied to what’s going on with the house—that’s when I can kind of freeze up or lose motivation. But outside of that, I’m still functioning. Does that make sense?
If someone shows you clear proof that the bank is not working with people at your job against you, are you able to believe it?

I mean… I would try to look at whatever they showed me. I don’t want to seem unreasonable.

But honestly, no, not really. The papers are exactly the problem, in a way. Everyone keeps acting like this is just foreclosure paperwork or missed payments, but I’ve been seeing the connections for almost two years now — the bank, the loan servicer, even certain people at my job. It feels like they’re quietly working together to push me out of my house.

So if someone showed me “proof,” I’d probably wonder what they left out or how it was arranged. I know that probably sounds bad, but that’s how it feels to me.
Did this belief that the bank and people at your job are working together against you begin suddenly?

Not suddenly, no… at least I don’t think so. It kind of built up.

It’s been about a year and nine months now, since the foreclosure notices and the bank calls started really taking over things at home. I tried to tell myself it was just normal stress at first, but over time it started feeling more connected, if that makes sense.
Compared with before this started, have you become less able to manage your work or daily life in general?

I don’t think I’m less able in general… at least, I hope not. I still get up and go to work, I’m supervising my team, doing schedules, handling customer issues. And I’m taking care of myself okay.

It’s more that when something seems connected to the house situation—like the mail, bank calls, or certain paperwork at work—that’s when I get stuck or thrown off. So it’s not everything, if that makes sense. It’s mostly when it feels tied to what’s happening with the foreclosure.
Have you felt that outside forces are controlling your actions or movements?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, nobody is making my body move or controlling my actions like that.

I do feel pressured sometimes, and like people are trying to corner me with decisions, but I’m still the one choosing what I do. Is that what you mean?
Besides this situation with the bank and your job, have you been seeing things that other people could not see?

No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been seeing things that other people couldn’t see… at least not that I’m aware of.

I mean, I notice things sometimes, like looks or timing of things, but not like seeing people or objects that aren’t there. Is that what you mean?
Before all of this started, had you ever had a period when you believed someone was plotting against you?

Before all this? No… not really. I mean, I’ve had normal worries like anyone, but nothing like this.

This is the first time I’ve felt sure that people were actually coordinating against me. I know that probably sounds… extreme, and I’m not trying to be difficult. It’s just, with the foreclosure, it hasn’t felt like simple paperwork or missed payments. The bank, the loan servicer, even some people at work—it feels like they’ve been quietly working together to push me out of my house. And that’s been going on for almost two years now.

I know they keep showing papers and saying it’s just the process, but that doesn’t change what I’ve been seeing.
Apart from the bank and people at work working together against you, have you had any other strong beliefs that other people say aren’t true?

No… I don’t think there’s anything else like that. It’s really this one situation.

I know people keep saying it’s just foreclosure paperwork and missed payments, and I understand why that sounds more reasonable. I’m not trying to make it sound bigger than it is. But I do feel like the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been working together quietly to push me out of my house.

That’s the main thing. I haven’t had other beliefs like that, not that I can think of.
